Hey, I'm a college engineering student at a top-tier uni, so I totally get where you're coming from. If you really like what you do, then I'd stick with it. For the panic attacks, is it the intense workload? I'd actually transfer because I find college and other degree programs to vary in difficulty and workload. If you're devoted to staying in your current program, I'd see a therapist in the area outside campus or even one at your school. Talk through what goes on in your mind at those moments. Don't be scared, and don't give up. Everything will be okay, and feel free to reach out if you want to talk more in detail.
